title: 1988 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Dragon
seo_title: 1988 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Dragon (17 February – 5 February 1989)
description: 1988 is the Year of the Earth Dragon (Yang, Wu-chen), from 17 February 1988 to 5 February 1989. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1988.
lead: Born in 1988? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dragon, but check the date: the 1988 Earth Dragon year began on 17 February 1988. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1988: Year of the Earth Dragon, from 17 February 1988 to 5 February 1989.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1988 was the Year of the Dragon. It began with Lunar New Year on 17 February 1988 and ended on 5 February 1989, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1988 ends in 8, which makes it an Earth year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1988 is a Wu-chen year. The same Earth Dragon combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1928 before it and 2048 after it.
Lunar New Year 1988 fell on 17 February 1988, so everyone born in January 1988, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rabbit.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dragon guide describes the sign like this: “Confident, charismatic, and ambitious. Dragons draw attention and often rise to leadership naturally.” The usual watch-out: “Can come across as proud or impatient with limitations.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Dragon page.
Careers often linked with the Dragon: leadership, entrepreneurship, entertainment, real estate.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1988
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dragon's best matches are the Rat, Monkey and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Dog, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dragon years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1964 (Wood Dragon); 1976 (Fire Dragon); 2000 (Metal Dragon); 2012 (Water Dragon). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1988 is the Year of the Dragon, a Yang Earth Dragon year (Wu-chen).
When does the 1988 Year of the Dragon start and end?
It starts on 17 February 1988 and ends on 5 February 1989.
I was born in January 1988. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rabbit: Lunar New Year 1988 was on 17 February 1988, so all of January 1988 belongs to the Rabbit year.
Earth. 1988 ends in 8, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dragon compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Monkey and Rooster. The Dragon's clash sign is the Dog.
